articles.title: India's central bank keeps benchmark rates steady, cites 'moderate' core inflation
articles.description: The Reserve Bank of India has kept interest rates unchanged amid creeping inflation.

articles.title: "You stole, please return some." Coldcard hacker's wallet becomes a graffiti wall of pleas and hustles
articles.description: A wallet holding $36 million in stolen bitcoin has become an unlikely public message board, as hack victims and opportunists pay to leave permanent notes for the thief.

articles.title: U.S. says Strait of Hormuz is 'free and open' as Bessent signals deal with Iran is close

articles.title: Bitcoin flat at $64,000 as stocks print records and Hormuz deal nears
articles.description: BTC held near $64,000 as MSCI's world index set another peak and Brent fell toward a Hormuz deal. Ether is the only major down on the week.

articles.title: Bybit’s EU payments arm secures Austrian e-money license

articles.title: Ethereum researchers want to rein in staking; critics say it could backfire
articles.description: EIP-8363 is a newly published draft proposal that would cut net consensus-layer rewards as the Ethereum staking ratio heads toward 50%.

articles.title: GM, Chinese automaker extend joint venture for 20 years despite geopolitical tensions with U.S.
articles.description: GM said the deal will focus on domestic sales of Buick and Cadillac models in China and exporting Chevrolet products built in China for non-U.S. markets.

articles.title: SpaceX's AI spending unnerves Wall Street despite promises of quick payoff
articles.description: In addressing Wall Street for the first time since SpaceX's IPO, executives tried to make the case that hefty AI investments are paying off within a year.

articles.title: SoftBank jumps 10% as Asia tech stocks track Wall Street AI rally
articles.description: Asian technology stocks rallied on Wednesday after Wall Street's record-setting session fueled optimism around artificial intelligence and growth stocks.

articles.title: China's super-rich 'in shock' and hunting for cash as Beijing issues surprise tax on offshore trusts

articles.title: Europe's heatwave isn't cooling Asian travelers' holiday plans for the continent

articles.title: Lucid begins 'operational reset' as CEO says EV maker will delay midsize vehicle
articles.description: The company didn't provide updated guidance. New CEO Silvio Napoli earlier this year suspended production expectations.

articles.title: Pinterest shares fall on lukewarm sales guidance

articles.description: Nicholas Charriere turned an hour of nonsense into a family website with named tracks. One reply calling him creepy got more likes than his post.

articles.title: Sen. Susan Collins will oppose Blanche, a critical blow for Trump's AG pick

articles.title: OpenAI Dumps Apple Employees' Text Messages to Fight Trade Secret Suit
